[EN] It's so crowded here.
But there's so much to see and do!
[ES] Hay mucha gente aquí.
¡Pero hay tanto que ver y hacer!

[EN] Lorrenia, you have a good time with Kibellia.
[ES] Lorrenia, diviértete con Kibellia.

[EN] Please take good care of her, Kibellia. I have to attend the private feast in the headquarters.
[ES] Por favor, cuida bien de ella, Kibellia. Tengo que asistir al banquete privado en el cuartel general.
